text:
China’s factory activity improved in August but remained in contraction territory for a second straight month, as a pickup in orders could not fully offset the impact of overall weak domestic demand and disruptions from extreme weather.
The manufacturing purchasing managers’ index (PMI) was 49.8 in August, up from 49.2 in July, according to data released by
text_zh: 中国8月工厂活动有所改善，但连续第二个月处于收缩区间，因订单回升未能完全抵消整体内需疲软和极端天气干扰的影响。数据显示，8月制造业采购经理指数（PMI）为49.8，高于7月的49.2。
